What is the basic accounting equation? Identify and describe the steps in the accounting 10   
cycle/process.
On July 1, 2018, Mr. Enam established ENAM TRAVEL AGENCY. The following transactions were completed during the month:

content.value_html:
2018 July 1Invested Tk. 1,00,000 cash to start the agency.
2018 July 2Paid Tk. 4000 cash for July office rent.
2018 July 3Purchased office equipment for Tk. 25,000 cash.
2018 July 4Incurred Tk. 3,000 of advertising costs in the "Daily Purbanchal" on account.
2018 July 5Paid Tk. 6,000 cash for office supplies.
2018 July 6Earned Tk. 95,000 for service rendered: Tk. 10,000 is received fromcustomers and Tk. Balance of Tk. 85,000 is billed to customer on account.
2018 July 7Withdraw Tk. 2,000 cash for personal use.
2018 July 8paid "Daily Purbanchal" amount due in transaction 4.
2018 July 9Paid employee salaries Tk. 22,000
2018 July 10Received Tk. 85,000 in cash from customer who have previous been billed intransaction 6.

content.value: (i) Journalise above the transactions in the book of MR. ENAM.
(ii) Prepare a tabular analysis of the transactions using the following column headings: 15 Cash: Accounts Receivable; Supplies; Office Equipment; Accounts Payable; and Enam's Capital.
